subject: ESA solutions returning case names as NA (QCA package)

messages.author: df5468b8c5e117c8
messages.subject: ESA solutions returning case names as NA (QCA package)
parts:
I noticed that the QCA package's "minimize" function doesn't properly show the case names, returning them as NA. I've also checked with the QCApro package, which, oddly enough, properly returned the names.

View reproducible example

R version 4.0.0 (2020-04-24)
QCA 3.7

messages.author: 53dbab5845ace6b6
messages.subject: Re: ESA solutions returning case names as NA (QCA package)
parts:
Hi Bruno,

Yes, this has already been reported, please see:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/qcawithr/tjBTdxxiZaw

The new version of package QCA has just been released on CRAN, it will just take a couple of more days before they will start producing the binaries for you to install.
This issue is fixed in this new version 3.8.

Best wishes,
Adrian

PS: great idea to use that link with the code and output, looks awesome
